remarks: A Greens Farms Opportunity with Character and Possibility Set in the heart of sought-after Greens Farms, this charming home offers both comfort today and exciting possibilities for tomorrow. With its Cape-to-Colonial design, the home combines character with a flexible layout-featuring two bedrooms on the main level and two upstairs. One of the spacious second-floor bedrooms could easily serve as a den, office, or media room, adapting to your lifestyle needs. The sun-filled living area is anchored by a newer kitchen, open to the living room for a modern, welcoming feel-perfect for gatherings and everyday living. Outdoors, the level .34-acre lot provides a peaceful setting with space to enjoy. Rarely does a home in Greens Farms come to market at such an approachable price point. Whether you're drawn by the neighborhood or the flexible spaces, this home is a true find in one of Westport's most desirable communities.
